theoretically.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人觉得这个计划怎么样？
theoretically.listen: Theoretically, this plan should work well.

theoretically.stem: We need a ______ explanation of how it works.
theoretically.why: 名词 explanation 前用形容词 theoretical。

theoretically.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
theoretically.stem: Theoretical, the new rule should help students a lot.
theoretically.why: 句首作状语修饰全句，要用副词 Theoretically。

theoretically.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
theoretically.zh: 理论上，这个计划会成功。
theoretically.why: in theory 意为“理论上”，与 theoretically 同义。

theoretically.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
theoretically.stem: ______, the two cities are the same size. (theoretical)
theoretically.why: 句首作状语要用副词 Theoretically。

theoretically.stem: Theoretically, our team should win, ______ we often lose.
theoretically.why: theoretically 只说“理论上”，常暗示实际未必如此，后用 but 转折。

theoretically.ask: 从 practice、theory 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
theoretically.stem: Theoretically the plan is perfect, but in ______ it is hard.
theoretically.why: in practice 意为“实际上”，与 theoretically 相对。

recover.ask: 听录音，回答问题：医生说什么？
recover.listen: He will recover from the illness soon.
recover.why: recover from 意为“从……中康复”。

recover.stem: She ______ from her bad cold last week.
recover.why: last week 表示过去，用过去式 recovered。

recover.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
recover.stem: Now he is slowly ______ from the accident. (recover)
recover.why: now 和 is 表示现在进行时，用 recovering。

recover.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
recover.stem: Scientists recover a new star last year.
recover.why: “发现”新事物用 discover 的过去式；recover 表示“找回、康复”。

recover.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
recover.zh: 昨天他找回了丢失的钱包。
recover.why: yesterday 表示过去，recover 意为“找回”，用过去式 recovered。

recover.stem: His ______ after the operation was slow.
recover.why: 物主代词 his 后要用名词 recovery。

recover.ask: 从 from、of 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
recover.stem: It took her a month to recover ______ the illness.
recover.why: recover from 是固定搭配，意为“从……中康复”。

recovery.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人说什么需要很长时间？
recovery.listen: The patient's full recovery will take a long time.

recovery.stem: Doctors helped him ______ from the illness.
recovery.why: help sb. do sth. 后用动词原形 recover。

recovery.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
recovery.stem: The recovery of the old temple took ten years.
recovery.why: 修复建筑、文物用 restoration；recovery 多指康复或经济复苏。

recovery.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
recovery.zh: 他上个月手术之后康复得很快。
recovery.stem: He ______ quickly after the operation last month.
recovery.why: last month 表示过去，用过去式 recovered。

recovery.ask: 从 from、of 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
recovery.stem: His recovery ______ the accident took two months.
recovery.why: recovery from 意为“从……中康复”。

recovery.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
recovery.stem: Doctors have seen many quick ______ this year. (recovery)
recovery.why: many 后接可数名词复数，recovery 变 recoveries。

recovery.stem: The ______ of the stolen money made the old man happy.
recovery.why: 这里 recovery 表示“找回、追回”这个动作。

trend.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人谈的是什么？
trend.listen: There is a new trend in young people's reading.
trend.why: new trend in reading 说的是阅读的新趋势。

trend.stem: Many new ______ in clothes appear each year.
trend.why: many 后面要接复数名词 trends。

trend.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
trend.stem: He has a trend to forget things.
trend.why: 描述人本身的习惯性倾向用 tendency，trend 指社会或市场的走向。

trend.ask: 从 trend、trends 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
trend.stem: The ______ of house prices is going up.
trend.why: the … of 结构里用单数名词 trend。

trend.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
trend.why: last year 是过去时间，动词用过去式 trended。

trend.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
trend.zh: 这些年出现了许多新潮流。
trend.stem: Many new ______ have appeared over the years.
trend.why: many 后面用复数 trends，over the years 配合现在完成时。

trend.stem: My sister has a ______ to be late for school.
trend.why: a tendency to do sth 指某人的倾向；trend 说社会或市场的走向。

trendy.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人觉得她的衣服怎么样？
trendy.listen: Her clothes are very trendy, but they are too expensive.
trendy.why: trendy 意为赶时髦的、时髦的。

trendy.stem: This shirt is ______ than that one.
trendy.why: than 前面用比较级 trendier（y 变 i 再加 er）。

trendy.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
trendy.stem: Her clothes are trendyer than mine.
trendy.why: trendy 变比较级时要把 y 变 i 再加 er。

trendy.ask: 从 trendy、trend 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
trendy.why: 形容词修饰 young man 用 trendy；trend 是名词。

trendy.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
trendy.stem: She bought the ______ clothes in the shop. (trendy)
trendy.why: the … in the shop 表最高级，用 trendiest。

trendy.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
trendy.zh: 这顶帽子比我那顶时髦。
trendy.why: than 前面用比较级 trendier。

trendy.stem: “Trendy”和“fashionable”都表示“时髦”，但“trendy”常暗示什么？
trendy.why: trendy 常带一点贬义，暗示一味追新、未必有品位；fashionable 是中性词。

noun.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人说名词是什么？
noun.listen: A noun is the name of a person, place or thing.
noun.why: noun 是名词，表示人、地点或事物的名称。

noun.stem: There are three ______ in this sentence.
noun.why: three 后面要接复数名词 nouns。

noun.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
noun.stem: These noun are all about animals.
noun.why: These 后面要用复数名词 nouns。

noun.ask: 从 noun、name 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
noun.why: 说人的名字用 name；noun 是语法上的“名词”。

noun.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
noun.stem: Write down all the ______ in the sentence. (noun)
noun.why: all the 后面接复数名词 nouns。

noun.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
noun.zh: 这个句子里有五个名词。

noun.stem: In “a good book”, the word “book” is a ______.
noun.why: 此处 book 表示事物名称，是名词；name 指具体的名字，不指词性。

renowned.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人说什么很出名？
renowned.listen: The restaurant is renowned for its fish.
renowned.why: be renowned for 是“因……而闻名”，句中说的是鱼。

renowned.stem: The city is renowned ______ its beautiful gardens.
renowned.why: be renowned for 是固定搭配，表示“因……而闻名”。

renowned.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
renowned.stem: The coach is renowned for train young players.
renowned.why: for 是介词，后面要接动名词 training。

renowned.ask: 从 renowned、notorious 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
renowned.stem: The man is ______ for cheating old people.
renowned.why: renowned 是褒义“享有盛誉的”，坏人做坏事要用贬义的 notorious。

renowned.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
renowned.zh: 这位歌手作为一名舞蹈家而享有盛誉。
renowned.stem: The singer is renowned ______ a dancer.
renowned.why: 表示“作为……而闻名”用 be renowned as。

renowned.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
renowned.stem: The ______ doctor has saved many lives. (renown)
renowned.why: renown 是名词，修饰名词 doctor 要用形容词 renowned。

renowned.stem: This garden is ______ than that one.
renowned.why: than 前面要用比较级；renowned 是多音节词，比较级加 more。

name.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人请对方做什么？
name.listen: Please write your name on the paper.
name.why: write your name on the paper 表示在纸上写名字。

name.stem: In "The old shop has a good name", "a good name" means ______.
name.why: a good name 指“好名声”，不是“好听的名字”。

name.ask: 从 name、fame 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
name.stem: The young actor is looking for ______ and money.
name.why: fame 指“名声”，name 主要指“名字”。

name.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
name.why: 主语 name 是单数，be 动词要用 is。

name.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
name.stem: The ______ of the two cities are the same. (name)
name.why: two cities 说明是复数，name 要用复数 names。

name.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
name.zh: 昨天他们用我爷爷的名字给这条街命名。
name.stem: Yesterday they ______ the street after my grandpa.
name.why: 句中有 yesterday，要用过去式 named；name ... after 是“以……命名”。

name.stem: The teacher will ______ the winner tomorrow.
name.why: will 后面用动词原形；这里 name 作动词，意思是“宣布、任命”。

rename.ask: 听录音，回答问题：他们去年对学校做了什么？
rename.listen: They renamed the school last year.

rename.stem: The street ______ after the hero last year.
rename.why: 街道是“被命名”的，last year 说明用过去分词构成的被动语态。

rename.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
rename.stem: The city renameed the street last year.
rename.why: rename 以 e 结尾，过去式去掉 e 再加 d。

rename.ask: 从 rename、name 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
rename.stem: They will ______ the new library after the writer.
rename.why: 给新图书馆取名用 name；rename 是把已有的名字换掉。

rename.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
rename.stem: They are ______ the little park now. (rename)
rename.why: now 表示正在进行，去掉 e 加 ing 变 renaming。

rename.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
rename.zh: 请不要给这个文件夹改名。
rename.why: don't 后面接动词原形 rename（重新命名）。

rename.stem: The word "rename" means to give something ______ name.
rename.why: re- 表示“再一次”，所以 rename 是“给……一个新名字”。

username.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人要你在这里输入什么？
username.listen: Please type your username in this box.
username.why: username 是登录用的用户名。

username.stem: Your ______ is the name you use to log in, not your real name.
username.why: 登录用的标识叫 username，真名是 name。

username.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
username.stem: Your username are too long for this box.
username.why: 主语 username 是单数，be 动词用 is。

username.ask: 从 username、name 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
username.stem: Please write your real ______ on the form.
username.why: 表格上写真名用 name；username 是登录名。

username.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
username.stem: This computer has three ______ on it. (username)

username.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
username.zh: 你可以用用户名和密码登录。
username.stem: You can log in ______ your username and password.
username.why: 用某物用介词 with，log in with … 是常用搭配。

username.stem: How many ______ does this game have?
username.why: How many 后面接复数名词 usernames。

nickname.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人想知道什么？

nickname.stem: We call him Bob, but Bob is only his ______.
nickname.why: 大家叫的那个名字是 nickname（昵称、外号）。

nickname.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
nickname.stem: Last year the students ______ their teacher “King”. (nickname)
nickname.why: last year 是过去时间，动词用过去式 nicknamed（去 e 加 d）。

nickname.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
nickname.stem: My nickname are hard to remember.
nickname.why: 主语 nickname 是单数，be 动词用 is。

nickname.ask: 从 nickname、name 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
nickname.stem: Please write your real ______ on the form, not your nickname.
nickname.why: 表格上写真名 name；nickname 是外号。

nickname.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
nickname.zh: 现在在学校他被大家叫做“猫”。
nickname.why: be nicknamed 被叫做，用被动语态；these days 表示现在，用 is。

nickname.stem: My two best friends have funny ______.
nickname.why: two 后面接复数名词 nicknames。

anonymous.ask: 听录音，回答问题：说话人说什么样的人捐了钱？
anonymous.listen: An anonymous person gave the school a lot of money.

anonymous.stem: The letter was sent ______, so nobody knows the writer.
anonymous.why: 修饰动词 was sent 要用副词 anonymously。

anonymous.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
anonymous.zh: 医生对我的个人信息保密。
anonymous.why: 知道是谁但不外传用 confidential。

anonymous.ask: 从 anonymous、confidential 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
anonymous.stem: Nobody knows who wrote this letter. The writer is ______.
anonymous.why: 没人知道作者是谁，用 anonymous（匿名的）。

anonymous.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
anonymous.stem: An anonymous letter were sent to the school.
anonymous.why: 主语 letter 是单数，be 动词用 was。

anonymous.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
anonymous.stem: The money was given to the school ______. (anonymous)
anonymous.why: 修饰动词 was given 用副词 anonymously。

anonymous.stem: Please keep this report ______; only the manager may read it.
anonymous.why: 知道是谁但不外传用 confidential；anonymous 是不知道是谁。

synonym.ask: 听录音，回答问题：“Big”和“large”在句子里被说成什么词？
synonym.why: are synonyms 说这两个词是同义词。
主语是两个词，be 动词后用复数 synonyms。

synonym.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
synonym.why: hot 与 cold 意思相反，应该说 antonyms（反义词）。

synonym.ask: 从 synonym、antonym 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
synonym.why: 意思相反的词是 antonym，small 与 big 相反。

synonym.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
synonym.zh: 你能给我一个“big”的同义词吗？
synonym.stem: Can you give me a ______ of "big"?
synonym.why: a … of 中间要用单数名词 synonym。

synonym.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
synonym.stem: This book lists many ______ of each word. (synonym)
synonym.why: many 后面接可数名词复数 synonyms。

synonym.stem: "That's ______ news — our team won the game!"
synonym.why: news 前用 big 不用 large，同义词并不能随意互换。

instal.ask: 听录音，回答问题：新校长是什么时候就职的？
instal.listen: The new headmaster was installed last Monday.
instal.why: was installed last Monday 说明是上周一就职的。
last Friday 表过去，市长是“被就职”的，用 was installed。

instal.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
instal.stem: A new judge were installed yesterday.
instal.why: 主语 a new judge 是单数，yesterday 表过去，用 was。

instal.ask: 从 instal、instals 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
instal.stem: Our school ______ a new headmaster every few years.
instal.why: 主语 our school 是单数，every few years 表习惯，用三单 instals。

instal.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
instal.zh: 我们将在五月让新校长就职。
instal.stem: We will ______ the new headmaster in May.
instal.why: will 后面接动词原形 instal。

instal.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
instal.stem: They are ______ the new system now. (instal)
instal.why: are … now 用现在分词，instal 要双写 l 再加 ing。

instal.stem: He was installed ______ chairman last year.
instal.why: be installed as + 职务，表示就任某职位。

install.ask: 听录音，回答问题：爸爸在手机上做了什么？
install.listen: My father installed a new app on my phone.
install.why: installed a new app 是给手机安装新应用。

install.stem: The workers ______ the new machine last Monday.
install.why: last Monday 表过去，用过去式 installed。

install.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
install.stem: The new app was install on my phone.
install.why: was 后面要用过去分词 installed，构成被动语态。

install.ask: 从 install、installation 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
install.stem: The ______ of the new system took two hours.
install.why: the … of 结构中要用名词 installation。

install.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
install.zh: 你能帮我安装这个新游戏吗？
install.stem: Can you help me ______ this new game?
install.why: help sb. do sth.，后面用动词原形 install。

install.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
install.stem: He is ______ a new app on his phone now. (install)
install.why: is … now 用现在分词 installing。

install.stem: It took us an hour to ______ the new tent.
install.why: 搭帐篷用 set up，install 指把设备固定安装好。

installation.ask: 听录音，回答问题：新灯的安装需要多长时间？
installation.listen: The installation of the new lights takes two days.
installation.why: installation 是“安装”，句中说安装新灯要两天。

installation.stem: The ______ of the new machine took two hours.
installation.why: the … of 中间要用名词 installation（安装）。

installation.ask: 从 installation、device 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
installation.stem: A camera is a useful electronic ______.
installation.why: 单个装置用 device；installation 指安装过程或整套设备。

installation.ask: 句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
installation.stem: She finished the install of the new app yesterday.
installation.why: the … of 结构里要用名词 installation。

installation.ask: 用所给单词的适当形式填空。
installation.stem: The school needs two new ______ in the lab. (installation)
installation.why: two 后面要用复数名词 installations。

installation.ask: 根据中文完成句子，每空一词。
installation.zh: 工人们明天将安装新机器。
installation.stem: The workers will ______ the new machine tomorrow.
installation.why: will 后面用动词原形 install，它是 installation 的动词形式。

installation.stem: I paid for the phone in six monthly ______.
installation.why: “分期付款”用 installment，别和 installation（安装）混淆。
